# Compico / OverlayComposer

> OverlayComposer shows all OBS stream widgets through one Browser Source, with a separate layout per OBS scene.
> Each documentation page below also exists as raw Markdown (the same URL ending in index.md), without navigation or styling.

## Start here
- [Writing plugins: HTML widgets and standalone Go (WebAssembly) plugins](https://compico.github.io/overlaycomposer/docs/plugin-development/index.md): self-contained guide, enough to build a plugin from scratch

## Documentation
- [Getting started](https://compico.github.io/overlaycomposer/docs/getting-started/index.md)
- [Connecting to OBS](https://compico.github.io/overlaycomposer/docs/obs-setup/index.md)
- [Layouts and editor](https://compico.github.io/overlaycomposer/docs/layouts/index.md)
- [Settings](https://compico.github.io/overlaycomposer/docs/settings/index.md)
- [Deck: control panel for a tablet](https://compico.github.io/overlaycomposer/docs/deck/index.md)
- [Widgets and plugins](https://compico.github.io/overlaycomposer/docs/plugins/index.md)
- [Troubleshooting](https://compico.github.io/overlaycomposer/docs/troubleshooting/index.md)

## Source
- [OverlayComposer on GitHub](https://github.com/compico/overlaycomposer)
